chapter: Cal Massey, Coltrane and the Jazztet
title: The Jazztet's touring and recordings
summary: Tyner recalls the Jazztet's touring, its few albums and its booking with George Wein before he left for Coltrane.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Before we explore your tenure with the John Coltrane Quartet, I just wanted to get a little more information about your experience with the Jazztet. Did you tour nationally, internationally?
I have the first recording, but did you do more recordings?
I think we did a couple albums.
I have that very first one.
I don’t think I did a lot of recording with them.
And touring-did you do national touring, did you have representation, was the business

Yeah, we had a guy who booked us . . . George Wein. but I didn’t stay long in the Jazztet because I wanted to be with John. When John left Miles he wanted to see what I wanted to do and I said I wanted to play with you. I think it was a good decision (laughs).
